title: Dog Night, 2007 · after
logline: The morning after eight years: the new bulb still in Wood's coat on the hook, and the dog asleep, and the strip done by the neon as planned. Wood takes the bulb out of the coat and puts it in the drawer with the pins. Someone else will replace it, next year. The strip doesn't know that yet.

panels.composition: The garage. The coat on the hook. WOOD taking the bulb out of its pocket.
